address: 233, Section 2, Anhe Road, Da'an District, Taipei, 106, Taiwan
bio: The decor, a seamless blend of faux-industrial style with minimalist chic, fosters a sophisticated yet cosy atmosphere. At the helm is a chef-owner who honed her skills at a world-famous restaurant in Paris, hence classic French techniques underpinning her ambitious creations. She champions a farm-to-table concept using fresh produce grown on the city's fringes, with the daily-made vegetable terrine standing out as a real highlight.
